Changing page or competition, or closing the application, discards responses. Hide pagination when the list fits on one page. Explicit activation opens or closes navigation. Collapse/expand preserves current page, selection, scroll context and answers. Questions follow original exam order. If no competitions are available, show an empty-state message without an action button. On phones, navigation opens as a drawer over the question content rather than shifting it. Support the application interface in Brazilian Portuguese and English.

lastReviewedPlanningCapture.assessment: Owner identified crowded planning-board elements; layout corrections made in 165f554.

competitionEntryDecision: On entry, select the first competition in the order presented by the available list. The release does not require sorting by date or name. The list source and its underlying order remain pending technical design.
drawerDecision: When the available width cannot accommodate the expanded sidebar and readable questions side by side, navigation opens as a modal overlay. Place the phone drawer open and close controls in the same position. Give the drawer an accessible name; move keyboard focus inside on open and contain it while open. Escape and a visible close control dismiss it and return focus to the trigger. Selecting a competition closes the drawer, restores focus to the trigger and announces the selected competition. Dismissing without selecting preserves the current question context.
drawerValidation: Start prototype testing at 1024 CSS px. Determine the final breakpoint by testing available width, zoom and long labels. Verify keyboard focus and screen reader announcements in the working prototype.
hubScope: One competition-question workspace. First available competition selected automatically. Ten questions per page. Explicit Answer, locked evaluation, retry and temporary responses. Ghost navigation; provisional app mark at rest; expand action on hover/focus. Original exam order; phone overlay drawer; empty message and list Retry; safe answer retry; Portuguese and English interface.
